description: Permanently delete a project: the app, its URL, every release and its environment variables. DESTRUCTIVE: this cannot be undone. Use it only when the user has explicitly asked, in this conversation, to delete this specific project; never on your own to free a project slot, fix an error or clean up. It works in two calls. The first call (without confirm) deletes nothing: it returns what would be deleted and a confirmationCode. Show that to the user and ask them to confirm. Only after they say yes, call again with confirm set to the exact project slug and the confirmationCode (valid 10 minutes, one use). A database is not deleted with the app; to remove the data as well, drop it first with configure_database.

confirm.description: Second call only: the exact project slug, after the user explicitly agreed.

confirmationCode.description: Second call only: the confirmationCode from the first call.

name: delete_project
